title: Next phase of enterprise AI not about deploying models, but managing their evolution: Report

title: OpenAI introduces new safety tool to protect user privacy
snippet: Under ZDR, OpenAI does not save a customer's prompts or the AI's responses once a task is finished. No OpenAI employee can view the content, and unless a company chooses to opt in, none of that data is used to train AI models.
